resources.string: Guess hidden 5- or 6-digit numbers using digit-by-digit clues.
Build a 5- or 6-digit number and submit your guess.
Good clue. Refine the next number.
Extra life used. Try the number again.
Complete full DigitShift rounds by finding the hidden number before you run out of guesses.
Build a hidden 5- or 6-digit number with digits 0–9 and submit it. Every guess reveals which digits are correct, present, or absent.
Green means the digit is correct, orange means it belongs somewhere else, and dark gray means it is not in the answer.
Each submitted guess upgrades the keypad. Reuse green digits, relocate orange ones, and avoid dark gray digits to solve faster.
Classic mode alternates between 5- and 6-digit rounds until you miss a number. Time Attack adds pressure, so solve quickly to bank score and bonus time.
Type the suggested number to learn the board.
Submit another number and watch the keypad update.
Use the clues and solve the hidden number.
